facts.text: The ROS 2 node is constructed with the literal name sick_scan2.
SickScanCommon creates a ROS 2 publisher for sensor_msgs::msg::LaserScan on the relative topic name scan with queue size 10.
The same constructor creates ROS 2 publishers for sensor_msgs::msg::PointCloud2 on cloud and sensor_msgs::msg::Imu on imu.
The scan path assigns the configured frame_id into the LaserScan header.
The scan path assigns the received timestamp into the LaserScan header before publication.
The node declares the frame_id parameter with the default string world.
The ASCII datagram parser derives angle_min from the datagram start angle, angle_increment from the angular step width, and angle_max from the sample count.
The ASCII datagram parser converts each raw distance value with iRange / 1000.0.
The binary scan path derives angle_min, angle_increment and angle_max from the start angle and angular step width, and writes each range as data[i] * 0.001 * scaleFactor + scaleFactorOffset.
The parser rejects a scan whose number of data points is below 1 or above the scanner model's number of shots.
The LRS_4XXX scanner configuration sets the parser's number-of-shots validation bound to 7201.
SickGenericParser initializes its range_min and range_max overrides to 0.05 and 100.0 in its constructor.
SickScanCommon::stop_scanner sends the SOPAS stream-disable command sEN LMDscandata 0 and returns its error code.
